tools.description: Answer questions about Existential Otter — the indie mobile puzzle game studio — from this site's own content: who the studio is, its game philosophy, the roadmap and upcoming games, the free-with-ads business model, the privacy policy (data collected, opt-outs, purchases, children, your rights), and how to contact support. Use for any question about the studio, its games, or its policies. Returns the most relevant content sections with source URLs; compose the answer from those sections.
